error_signature: Container killed by YARN for exceeding memory limits
keywords: Container killed by YARN for exceeding memory limits
action_taken: Increase spark.executor.memory to 8g (or higher) and re-run the job. Also consider increasing spark.executor.memoryOverhead.

error_signature: Unable to connect to metastore or Connection refused
keywords: Could not connect to the endpoint
action_taken: Retry the job after 5-10 minutes. Check if the metastore or external service is temporarily unavailable.
Investigate the stack trace, fix the null handling in the application code, and redeploy the job.

error_signature: No space left on device or disk full
action_taken: Clean up temporary files or increase disk size on the cluster nodes. Check yarn.nodemanager.local-dirs usage.

error_signature: Shuffle fetch failed or Executor lost
action_taken: Increase spark.shuffle.memoryFraction or spark.executor.memory. Consider reducing the number of partitions if data skew is present. Retry the job.
Add retry logic or increase fs.s3a.attempts.maximum. Retry the job after a short delay.
Increase task execution_timeout or optimize the task. If transient, clear and retry the task.

error_signature: Sensor timed out waiting for condition
action_taken: Check if the upstream data/file arrived late. Increase sensor timeout/poke_interval or switch to reschedule mode. Clear and retry if data is now available.

error_signature: Upstream task failed or upstream_failed state
action_taken: Fix or clear the failed upstream task first. Then clear this task so it can run.

error_signature: DAG import error or broken DAG
keywords: Error when trying to load the DAG
action_taken: Fix the Python import/syntax error in the DAG file and redeploy. Check Airflow UI > Browse > DAG Import Errors.
Check Airflow metadata DB (Postgres/MySQL) health, credentials, and network. Restart scheduler/webserver if needed after DB is healthy.

error_signature: S3 access denied or permission error from Airflow task
action_taken: Fix IAM role/policy or Airflow connection credentials for S3. Verify the task's AWS connection and bucket policy.
Increase task memory/CPU requests/limits in the pod template or operator. Clear and retry the task after adjusting resources.

error_signature: Airflow connection not found or invalid
action_taken: Create or fix the Airflow Connection (Admin > Connections) with the correct conn_id used by the task.
